nodes.name: inviteDefaults.ts
nodes.summary: Defines invite lifecycle defaults (usage limits, expiry window, role) for org bootstrap and panel-created invites, plus helpers that compute an expiry timestamp and assemble a default invite record.

nodes.name: getInviteExpiresAt
nodes.summary: Computes an ISO-8601 expiry timestamp a given number of days from now (or from a supplied reference date).

nodes.name: createInviteDefaults
nodes.summary: Builds the default InviteDefaults record (usage limit, expiry, member role) based on whether the invite is a bootstrap or panel invite.

nodes.name: protocol.ts
nodes.summary: Zod schemas for the collaboration wire protocol consumed by the managed ORG2 Cloud plane, validating RemoteTeammateSessionMetadata and its enum sub-schemas, plus a deterministic avatar identity helper.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses zod's `satisfies z.ZodType<T>` idiom to keep runtime schemas structurally aligned with the hand-written TypeScript interfaces in types.ts, with `.nullish().transform()` chains normalizing null server values to undefined.

nodes.name: createCollabAvatarIdentity
nodes.summary: Deterministically derives a two-letter avatar initials string and a color variant from a member's display name.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the backend-agnostic collaboration wire types consumed by the managed ORG2 Cloud plane: session access/visibility/replay-level consts, org and member record shapes, and the RemoteTeammateSessionMetadata interface with fork lineage and comment-task provenance.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the `as const` object + derived union type idiom (e.g. `COLLAB_ROLE` const paired with `CollabRole = (typeof COLLAB_ROLE)[keyof typeof COLLAB_ROLE]`) throughout instead of TypeScript enums.
